prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
At Mazda Stadium on August 16, Hanshin gave Hiroshima little time to settle.

In the first inning, Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field. Hanshin took the lead almost immediately.

That lead was supported by a steady start from Rihito Ihara. The Hanshin starter allowed only two hits and one run in five innings, giving his team a strong base.

Hiroshima’s only run came in the fifth inning, when Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run. It was the home team’s only score of the night.

Hanshin added more runs in the seventh and eighth innings, making the lead too large for Hiroshima to close.

When the final out was made, the scoreboard showed:

Hiroshima 1–8 Hanshin

This was not a back-and-forth game. Hanshin struck first, stayed in control, and extended its lead as the night went on.

【Point One】
Montero’s home run gave Hiroshima one bright moment. But a solo home run brings home only one run, and this one remained alone. Hiroshima did not turn that big hit into a longer attack. The 8–1 result was clear: the home team had a big hit, but not a rally.

【Point Two】
Hanshin’s final margin was built on more than Sato’s opening swing. Seishiro Sakamoto delivered a timely hit in the seventh inning and another timely double in the eighth. Pinch-hitter Torai Fushimi also came through with a timely hit. More than one player contributed to the late scoring, making the win feel complete.
